%1$s Kanpa ñawpak rurayta wakaychinkapak, AN Paint kunan mana payllatak shuyuta wakaychinchu. Kanpa ñawpak rurayta wakaychinkapak, “Wakaychishkakuna → Ñawpak rurayta kutichinkapak wakaychina…” nishkata akllay. Kanpa kunan rurayta wakaychinkapak, “Wakaychishkakuna → Imashina wakaychinata akllana…” nishkata akllay (PNG / JPEG).

%1$s AN Paint kanpa ñawpak rurayta kutichinkapak chikan wakaychirka. “Wakaychishkakuna → Ñawpak rurayta kutichinkapak wakaychina…” nishkata akllay. ZIP ukumanta canvas.png nishka shuyuta surkuy. Chay shuyuta paskankapak “Wakaychishkakuna → Shuyuta paskana…” nishkata akllay. Mutsurikpi, “Allichina → Shuyuna kiti → Shuyupa tuputa tikrachina…” nishkata akllay.

Kay PNG ukupi ña akllashka shuk chikan shuyu tiyan. Kuyurik shuyukunapa rantika chay shuyutami AN Paint churanka. Wakaychishpaka mana kuyurik shuyuta ruranka.

Kay %1$s-ta tantiyankapak ancha sinchimi; ukupi shukmanta ashtawan shuyu tiyanchu mana tiyanchu, mana yachayta ushanchu. AN Paint mana kuyurik shuyullata paskanka; ima kuyuriytapash mana wakaychankachu.
Kay ruraypak RAM mana paktanchu. Shuyukunapa tantachiypak wakaychishka ñawpak shuyukunataka AN Paint charinrakmi.
Ñawpak tupupi kay rurayta rurankapak RAM mana paktanchu. AN Paint mana payllatak shuyupa tuputa tikrachirkachu.
Kay shuyuta paskayta tukuchinkapak RAM mana paktanchu
Kay shuyuta rikunkapak RAM mana paktanchu
Kunan ruraypak churashka RAM-pakka ancha hatunmi. Tupukunata uchillachiy, mana kashpaka kay rurayta sakiy, RAM-pi kitita kachariy.
Android kay shuyuta paskayta mana usharkachu.
Kuchushka kitipa patakpash aksipash shuk pixelmanta mana ashtawan uchilla kachun.
Kuchunapak yupaykuna 0 kachun, mana kashpaka 0-manta ashtawan hatun kachun.
%1$s-ta chikan wakaychirka. Kanpa tukuy shuyupi manarak wakaychishka allichiykuna tiyan; shuyuta shuktakwan rantichinapak ñawpa, tukuy shuyupa kikinllata wakaychiy.
Chikan wakaychirka. Katinkapak ñawpa, kunan shuyuta wakaychinkapak “Wakaychina” mana kashpaka “Imashina wakaychinata akllana…” nishkata akllay.
Shuk iconota, Base64 killkata mana kashpaka ASCII shuyuta chikan wakaychina. Kashna chikan wakaychishpaka kunan shuyutapash “Wakaychina” nishkapa wakaychina kititapash mana tikrachinchu.

Shuyupa wakaychiy samitapash willayta ñitishpa wakaychinapak akllashkakunatapash akllay. “Wakaychina” nishkata akllashpaka kikin shutitapash, maypi wakaychinatapash, samitapash, akllashkakunatapash kutin churanka.
Kan akllashka kitipi shuyupa kikinllata wakaychiy; chay kipaka rakinakunkapak shuk appta akllay. “Wakaychina” nishkapa kunan wakaychina kitita mana tikrachinchu.
Shuyuta wakaychirka, shinapash Android rakinakuyta paskayta mana usharkachu: %1$s
Tukuchishka shuyuta akllashka wakaychina kitipi churayta mana usharkachu.
Allichiykunata kutichinkapak willayta wakaychiyta mana ushanchu. Kanpa Android-pi wakaychinkapak kitita kachariy, kutin ruray.
Allichiykunata kutichinkapak wakaychishka willaypi mana shuyashka willay tiyan.
Shuyuta kutichirka, shinapash allichiykunata kutichinkapak willayta paskayta mana usharkachu. Ñawpak rurayta kutichinkapak chikan wakaychirka.

Ñawpak rurayta kutichinkapak ZIP-ta wakaychirka. ZIP ukumanta canvas.png-ta surkuy; “Wakaychishkakuna → Shuyuta paskana…” nishkawan paskay. ZIP ukupi ruraypa akllashkakunapash tiyan. Shuyuman manarak tantachishka akllashka kiti tiyakpika, chaypash ZIP ukupi tiyan.

Hawa lluki kuchumanta pixelkunata kikin kitipillapi charin. Shuyuna kitita uchillachishpaka alli mana kashpaka uray manyamanta kanchapi kak pixelkunata anchuchin; “Ñawpak rurayman kutichina” nishkaka chaykunata kutichin.
PDF pankakunamanta 144 dpi tupupi shuyuta ruran. Killkapash vector shuyukunapash pixelkunaman tikrarin.
Achikpash yanapash rikurik unanchakunawan killkallata ruran. Sapan unancha kikin patakta charik killka samiwan rikuy. Kayka killkawan rurashka shuyumi; ñawpak shuyu hina kutin paskayta mana ushanchu.
Shuyupa willayta (rurakpa shuti, maymanta shamushka, licencia, shuktak killkakuna) wakaychiyta mana kashpaka kutichiyta mana usharkachu. Ña wakaychishka willayta charinrakmi. Kutin ruray.
Kay shuyupa willayta (rurakpa shuti, maymanta shamushka, licencia, shuktak killkakuna) yapashpaka rurayta kutichinkapak ancha hatun kanka. Kanpa ñawpak shuyutapash willaytapash charinrakmi.
Shuyupa wakaychishka wakin willayta (rurakpa shuti, maymanta shamushka, licencia, shuktak killkakuna) paskayta mana usharkachu. Wakaychishkakunata charinrakmi.
Shuyupakpash wakaychinkapak willayta rurana RAM kitikunapakpash mutsurishka RAM tantachishkaka chikan wakaychinkapak churashka RAM-manta ashtawan hatunmi.
Mana kuyurik shuyu; 256 tullpukama. Dithering tullpumanta tullpuman tikrayta llampuyachin. Kuyurik GIF-kunamanta shukniki shuyullata paskan.
Shutita killkay: ama /, \\ nishkakunata churaychu; ama kamachik unanchakunata (control characters) churaychu.
Ashtawan alli shuyu kachun akllashpaka ashtawan ñutu willaykunata wakaychin. Ashtawan kutinkunapi wakaychishka shuyu ashtawan achka wakaychina kitita hapin.

Kay shuyuka tullpukunata imashina rikuchinata willak willayta charin; AN Paint chay willayta manarak tikrachiyta ushanchu. Kaypi churankapak ñawpa, tullpukunapa chay willayta ushashpa shuyuta allichik appwan sRGB PNG-man tikrachiy.

Kay shuyukunapa tantachiyta rurankapak kunan churashka RAM-manta ashtawan RAM mutsurinka nishpa yupashkami, ashtawan uchilla shuyuta rurashpapash. Kunan churashka RAM-wanka tantachiypa tupukunata uchillachishpalla mana paktanchu. Kutin rurankapak ñawpa, shuktak paskashkakunata wichkay mana kashpaka ashtawan uchilla ñawpak shuyuta allichiy. Kanpa tantachiy mana tikrarishkachu.

%1$d × %2$d pixels (%3$.2f MP) allita allichinkapak kunan sakishka %4$.2f MP tupumanta ashtawan hatunmi. AN Paint tukuy shuyuta RAM-pi charin; shuyuta tikrachinkapakpash akllashka kitikunapakpash kitita sapanlla charin. Kunan ushana RAM-mi kay tuputa kamachin. Ancha hatun shuyupak RAM kitita manarak churashpa kay rurayta sakirka. AN Paint mana payllatak shuyupa tuputa tikrachirkachu.
Ashtawan alli shuyu kachun akllashpaka, ashtawan kutinkunapi wakaychishka shuyu ashtawan achka wakaychina kitita hapin. Lossless-wanka tullpupa sapan yupayta mana tikrachishpa wakaychin.

Yupashka RAM ukupi kunan shuyuna kitipakpash, llutankapak wakaychishka shuyupakpash (clipboard), tukuy shuyuta ashalla pixelkunawan paskankapakpash (sampled decoding), allichinkapakpash RAM kitikuna tiyan. Chikan ruraypi ushashka RAM tikrarin. Ashtawan uchilla kikin shuyupi ñutu willaykuna chinkan. Ñawpak wakaychishka mana tikrarinchu.

Kay wakaychiy samiwan tupukunata tikrachinkapak ñawpa, ñawpak shuyuta mana kashpaka shuyupa rakikunata RAM-pi paskana kan. Ashtawan uchilla shuyuta rurashpapash, kunan ushana RAM mana paktanman.
Ashtawan uchilla shuyuta rurankapak akllashpapash, kunan sakishka RAM-wanka kay shuyuta allichinkapak paskayta mana ushanchu. Kay rurayta sakiy; ashtawan uchilla ñawpak shuyuta churay.
Shuyuta paskankapakpash allichinkapak RAM kitikunapakpash %1$s RAM mutsurin nishpa yupashkami; allita allichinkapak kunan churashka RAM-ka %2$s-mi. Ashtawan uchilla kikin shuyuta akllay.

Tukuy shuyupakpash ruraypak RAM kitikunapakpash mutsurishka RAM-ka kunan allita rurankapak churashka RAM-manta yallin, mana kashpaka Android chay RAM kitikunata churayta mana usharkachu. Kikin shuyupa tuputa tikrachiy, chayta allichinkapak. Ñawpak wakaychishka mana tikrarinkachu.

Uchilla shuyuta ñitishpa hapiy, mana kashpaka llamkana kitipi churashka shuyuta aysay; chaymanta unanchashka manyapi sakiy. Washata ashalla rikuchik ñawpakta rikunaka llutachishkapa kikin rurayta rikuchin. Alli makiman llutachiy hawa manyakunata pakta churan; urayman llutachiy lluki manyakunata pakta churan. Uchilla shuyuta ñitiyta ushanki, chaymanta + churana ñitiy. Llutachishpaka ñawpak shuyu kallari kitipi kallarin. Shuk shuyuta kuchukpika payman llutarishka shuyukuna kuyurinman. Llutachishpaka shuyukuna shuk kitillapi kana mana sakirinchu.

Shuyuta akllay, X/Y yupaywan churana kiti llamkachiy hawa lluki kuchupa X/Y coordenadakunata hunta pixelkunapi churankapak, ceromanta kallarishpa. Shuktak shuyukuna kikin kitipi sakin; kaypi shuyukuna shuk kitillapi kana ushan.

Churashka kitimanta anchuchinaka akllashka shuyullata uray churana kitiman kutichin. Shuktak shuyukuna churashkalla sakin; llutarishka shuyukuna chushak kitita huntachinkapak kuyurinman. Tukuyta rikuchina tukuy tantachishkata rikunkapak hatunyachiyta allichin; llukshina tupukunata mana tikrachinchu.

Kamachikkunata rikunkapak shuk tabta akllay. Rikuna Rikuna kitita kuyuchinawan kallarin; Shuyuna ukupi Shuyu, Akllay, Churana tiyan. Rikuna kitita kuyuchina mana shuyushpa rikuna kitita kuyuchin; hatunyachinkapak ishkay rukata llamkachiy. Tabkunapa manyapi wachina panelta uchillachishpa pakan. Tukuy llamkanakuna shutiyuk. Allichina akllashkata, shuyuna kitipa saywakunata, tupukunata mana kashpaka shuyuta tikrachin. Tullpu ñawpak washa tullpukunata akllan; Tullpukunapa kitita turkana paykunata tikrachin, Yana / yurakman kutichina yana yurakman kutichin. Tullpu akllana akllashkata chaylla rikuchin. Tullputa churana sinchiyachin; Sakina ñawpak tullpuman kutichin. Tullputa yapana mana kashpaka chushak wakaychina kitita ñitiy tullputa akllashpa wakaychinkapak. Wakaychishka tullputa ñitishpa hapiy allichinkapak mana kashpaka anchuchinkapak. Ashtawan allichinakuna Yana / yurakman kutichina manyapi ñutu allichinata paskan. Pixel llika shuyu pixel tupunakunatapash rikuchin; Cursorwan shuyuna hatunyachina manyapi kunan x/yta rikuchin. Imashina wakaychinata akllana… shuyu samita, compresión allichinakunata, kitita akllan; Wakaychina chay allichinakunawan chaypilla kutin killkan. Chikan wakaychina… ICOta, ASCII shuyuta, Base64 killkata ruran, shuyuta wakaychishka shina mana unanchashpa. Wakaychina, rakinakuna kikin shuyuta wakaychin, chaymanta Android rakinakunata paskan. Kunan Wakaychinapa churana kitita charin. Shuyuna > Churana > Shuktak shuyukuna ukupi dispositivopa wakaychishkakuna, Catrobat, Irasutoya, Openclipart, «Wikimedia Commons · Mapakuna (Blank maps)…» tiyan. Churashka shuyukuna akllashkalla sakin; rikuna hapinakunata shuyuna kiti hawapipash rikuchin. Shuyuta shuyuna kitipi paktachina churashka kitita tikrachin; Ñawpak tupu ñawpak tupukunata kutichin. Programa kutin paskarikpi payllatak wakaychina ñawpak rurayta, Ñawpak rurayman kutichina/Kutin rurana ishkantin katichiykunatapash kutichin. Wakaychishkakuna ukupi Shuyukunata tantachishpa allichina…, Imashina llamkachina, AN Paintmanta, licenciakuna, rurakkunamanta willay tiyan. Killkata churana patakpi sayakpipash killkayta sakirin.

Rikuna, Shuyuna, Wakaychishkakuna, Allichina mana kashpaka Tullputa akllay chay tabpa kamachikkunata rikunkapak. Tabkunapa manyapi wachina panelta pakan mana kashpaka kutin rikuchin. Sayak pantallapi tabkunapash llamkana suniyakpash patakpi rin; ashtawan kamachikkunata tarinkapak aysay. Sirik pantallapi tabkunapash ñawpak llamkanakunapash lluki ladopi urayman rin. Shuyunapi Shuyu, Akllay, Churana tiyan. Shuyu Killkana, Tullpuk-kaspi, Yaku tullpu, Wayrawan tullpunata tantachin. Akllay chusku kuchu, munashka rikchaywan akllanakunata tantachin. Churana suniyakkunata, sami shuyukunata, killkata tantachin. Shuk tantachiyta ñitiy yuyashka llamkanata akllankapak, llamkanakunata allichinakunata rikunkapak: sayakpi suniyakpa uraypi, sirikpi alli maki ladopi. Akllashka tantachiyta kutin ñitiy llamkanakunata allichinakunata pakankapak mana kashpaka mastarinkapak. Tantachiykuna kay llamkaypi tukurik llamkachishka llamkanata yuyarin. Ashtawan allichinakunapak akllana panelta aysay. Umapi wakaychishkapa shuti, utkalla ruraykuna tiyan. Tullpu tabpi FG/BG tullpu rikuchik, Tullpukunapa kitita turkana, Yana / yurakman kutichina, Ashtawan allichinakuna tiyan. Tullputa allichinkapak rikuchikpa ñawpak mana kashpaka washa tullpu rakita ñitiy. Umapi urayman kikin tullpu churana, wakaychishka tullpukuna tiyan. Ñawpak tullpupak kikin tullpu rikuchikta ñitiy, washa tullpupak ñitishpa hapiy. Kikin tullpu churanapa alli maki manyapi chusku kiti tukurik llamkachishka tullpukunata charin; ñawpak tullpupak ñitiy, washa tullpupak ñitishpa hapiy. Tullpu allichinapi Tullpu tantachiy, Mishki tantachina shina, Ashtawan allichinakuna tiyan. Ashtawan allichinakuna ukupi Tullpukunapa mastariy, Muyu, RGB, HSV, HSL, sukta sanampayuk hex kamachikkuna tiyan. Kikinpa tullpukuna Pale Violet (#5B67FF), Kuri #FFD700, Kullki #C0C0C0, Anta #B87333wan kallarin. Wakaychishka tullputa ñitiy ñawpak tullpu shina llamkachinkapak; ñitishpa hapiy washa tullputa akllankapak, allichinkapak mana kashpaka anchuchinkapak. Tullputa yapana mana kashpaka chushak wakaychina kiti tullputa wakaychinkapak allichinata paskan. Kikin documento washa mana rikuchinchu. Washa rikuchik shuyuta shuyuna kiti shina paskashpa, washa rikuchik kitikunata kunan BG tullpuwan huntachin. Churashka shuyu kuyurina akllashka shina sakin; sinchiyachishpaka washa rikuchik kitikuna ñawpak shuyuna kitita rikuchin. Wikimedia Commons apamushkakuna churana ñawpak yurak washata chaskin. Ñawpak wakaychishkakuna mana tikrarinchu.

Rikuna > Rikuna kitita kuyuchina: shuk rukawan aysay rikuna kitita kuyuchinkapak; ishkay rukawan hatunyachiy, uchillachiy, kuyuchiy ima. Rikuna kitita kuyuchinapa akllanakunapi Shuyunata kutin akllay mana kashpaka shuyuna llamkanata akllay shuyuyman kutinkapak. Ishkay rukawan kuyuchiy shuyuna llamkanakunawanpash rurarin, shuyushka unanchakunata mana sakishpa. Uray alli maki ladopi aysana 100%pi chawpi suniyakta charin. Hatunyachina/uchillachina ñitinakuna shuk puriy 100%ta yallina kashpaka chaypi shayan; katinkapak kutin ñitiy. Manyapi Tukuyta rikuchina ñitina shuyuna kitita, kuyurina akllashkatapash rikuna kitipi paktachin, chawpipi churan. Rikuna kitita kuyuchinapi 100%pash tiyan; Rikuna pixel llikata kun.

Payllatak wakaychina allichiyta ashalla samachishpa, programamanta llukshishpapash kunan ñawpak rurayta wakaychin. Estado ñawpak ruray wakaychishka mana kashpaka payllatak wakaychina pantayta rikuchin. Kutin paskay ñawpak rurayta, wakaychishkapa shutita, llamkana allichinakunata, kuyurina akllashkata, manarak tukurishka geometríata kutichin. Payllatak wakaychina sapalla llamkana ñawpak rurayta charin. Wakaychishkakunapi PNG, alli kayta allichina JPEG, alli kayta allichina HEIC, mana chinkachik mana kashpaka chinkachik JPEG XL, WebP, AVIF tiyan. Imashina wakaychinata akllana… shuyu samita, allichinakunata, kitita akllan; Wakaychina chaypi kutin killkan. Chikan wakaychina…, Wakaychina, rakinakuna kikin shuyuta killkan, kunan Wakaychinapa kitita mana tikrachishpa, shuyuta wakaychishka shina mana unanchashpa. Wakaychina, rakinakuna chaymanta Android rakinakunata paskan. Wakaychishkapa shutipi kuyllurka shuyupi manarak wakaychishka tikrachiy tiyan nishkami. Payllatak wakaychina ñawpak shuyu wakaychishkakunata hawapi killkashpa mana rantichinchu.

Akllanakuna: chusku kuchuta mana kashpaka munashka rikchaywan manyata shuyuy. Kuyuchinkapak ukupi aysay; tuputa tikrachinkapak chusku kuchu hapinata mana kashpaka manyapa chawpi hapinata aysay; muyuchinkapak muyu hapinata aysay. Pataktapash aksitapash kikin patsak pitiwan tikrachina kallari kawsachishka; patakta aksita sapalla aysankapak wañuchiy. Manya hapinakuna akllashka manyapi tuputa tikrachin. Munashka rikchaywan akllanakuna tikrachina kiti ukupi akllashka sami shuyuta charin, muyuchishka payllatak wakaychishka kashpapash. Tupukunapash ángulopash akllana panelpi rikurin. Akllashka kitita shuyuman tantachina rurayta churan; akllashka allichiyta kutichina ushanki, payllatak wakaychina manarak tukurishka tikrachiykunata charin. Kikinllata rurana, Kuchuna, Akllashka kitikama kuchuna tikrachishka shuyuta llamkachin. Tukuyta akllana Allichina > Akllay ukupi tiyan, Ctrl+A hawa teclado ukupi rurarin. Kuchuna, Kikinllata rurana, Llutana umapi utkalla ruraykuna. Akllana mascarakuna akllashka sami shuyuta charin; kikin documento washa mana rikuchinchu.

Shuyuna kitipa saywakuna: maykan manyapipash kuchunkapak hapinakunata ukuman aysay mana kashpaka mastarinkapak hawaman aysay, chaymanta Akllashka manyakunata churana. Mushuk kiti BGta llamkachin; ñawpak pixelkuna mana hatunyachishka mana uchillachishka. Sakina, Ñawpak rurayman kutichina tiyan. Shuyupa tuputa tikrachina…, Shuyuna kitipa tupu…, Mushuk shuyu Pixel mana kashpaka Percent chaskin, patak-aksi tupapurata sinchiyachina akllanawan.

Killkana 1 pixelwan kallarin, kikin patakta yuyarin. Kikin yupayta killkankapak rikuchishka yupayta ñitiy. Shunku, Kuyllur, Wachina shuktak sami shuyukuna shina manya/huntachiy akllanakunata charin.
